query: SELECT metadata,user_id,grants,deleting,revision,totp_key_id FROM password_item_entities WHERE team_id=$1 AND deleted_at IS NULL AND NOT deleting AND (user_id=$3 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(grants) grant_entry WHERE (grant_entry->>'kind'='user' AND grant_entry->>'id'=$3) OR (grant_entry->>'kind'='team' AND grant_entry->>'id'=$1::text))) AND position(lower($2) in lower(metadata->>'name') || ' ' || lower(COALESCE(metadata->>'url',''))) > 0 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 500
